snippet.title: Nature Minds عقول الطبيعة – Official 4K Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience an action-adventure shaped by ancient Arabian legends.
Awaken on a quiet shoreline, uncover the ancient Bracelet of Dilmun, and confront the Three Impossible Legends — the Ghoul, the Phoenix, and the Loyal Friend.

🎮 Play the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900200/Nature_Minds/

🌍 Follow Tmtam Studio:
Website: https://tmtamstudio.com

Instagram: https://instagram.com/tmtamstudio
